faq.title: Questions, trust and safety
faq.lead: Everything you need to use Scoutica with confidence, on both sides of the lens.

safety.title: Our commitment
items: Scouts, agencies and brands are vetted before they can contact models: no anonymous profiles.
Contact details stay private. Requests go through the platform and you decide what to accept.
No commission on bookings and no payment required from models to be visible.
You can report a profile or message at any time: the team reviews every report.
The platform is for adults only: date of birth is verified at registration.

items.a: Yes, and it stays that way forever. You can build your profile, upload your portfolio, receive requests and apply to castings at no cost.
Only vetted scouts, agencies, brands and studios. You always see who is reaching out and can accept or decline each contact request.

items.q: How do I make my profile stand out?
items.a: Complete your profile and publish at least three photos. You can also activate a Boost to rank higher in searches for a limited time.

items.q: Do I need to be 18 to use Scoutica?
items.a: Yes. Scoutica is reserved for users aged 18 and over, and date of birth is verified at registration.

items.q: Why do I have to get verified?
items.a: Verification protects models and keeps the environment professional. Once vetted you can search talent, contact them and launch castings.

items.q: What does the free plan include?
items.a: You can browse profiles and send a limited number of contact requests per month. Paid plans unlock unlimited contacts, advanced filters and saved searches.

items.q: How does the free trial work?
items.a: All paid plans include a 14-day trial. You can cancel anytime before renewal with no charge.

items.q: How do I list my studio?
items.a: Create a listing with photos, services and availability. Vetted users can send you booking requests directly through the platform.
Studio is a dedicated plan with a 14-day free trial. You'll find up-to-date details on the pricing page.

about.title: About us
about.lead: An editorial platform for Italian fashion. Talent, eye, place — one system.
about.intro1: Scoutica was born from the need to modernize the world of scouting in Italian fashion. Too often, contact between models and industry professionals happens through informal channels, Instagram DMs, and unstructured manual processes.
about.intro2: Our mission is to create a professional, safe, and transparent space where models can present themselves at their best and where verified scouts, agencies, and brands can discover new talent efficiently and respectfully.

whyNow.title: Italian fashion deserves its own platform.
whyNow.body: Italy is the fourth fashion market in the world by revenue, yet its scouting still lives on DMs, IG screenshots, and private phone rubrics. In 2026 this is no longer acceptable — not for the talent, not for those searching, not for the brands who want to work properly.

about.safetyDesc: Every professional is verified by our team. Models have full control over who can contact them.
about.professionalismDesc: Scoutica is not a social network. It is a professional platform designed for those who work seriously in the fashion industry.
about.qualityDesc: We guide models in creating complete and professional profiles that represent them at their best.
about.italyFirstDesc: Scoutica is designed for the Italian market. We know the territory, the agencies, and the needs of the industry.

items.d: Public pricing. Clear commissions. No hidden upsell.
Scouts pass through a documental check made by people, not algorithms.
The talent decides who sees what. Always. No exceptions.
A profile curated like a magazine, not like a CV.
Italian by default. English for foreign clients. Everything else is the client.

metadata.title: Scoutica — The Italian platform for professional scouting
metadata.description: The professional platform that connects models with verified scouts, agencies and brands in Italy.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Scoutica is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your personal data in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR).

dataController.title: Data Controller
dataController.content: The data controller is Scoutica, based in Italy. For any request regarding personal data, contact: privacy@scoutica.it

dataCollected.title: Data Collected
dataCollected.content: We collect the following personal data: full name, email address, date of birth, body measurements, physical characteristics, portfolio photographs, social media links, city and region of residence, payment data (processed via Stripe), browsing data and technical cookies.

purpose.title: Purpose of Processing
purpose.content: Your data is processed for: account creation and management, profile publication, connecting models with scouting professionals, managing casting and job applications, payment processing, service notifications, platform improvement and security.

legalBasis.title: Legal Basis
legalBasis.content: Processing is based on: your explicit consent (art. 6.1.a GDPR), performance of the service contract (art. 6.1.b GDPR), legitimate interest for platform security (art. 6.1.f GDPR).

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content: You have the right to: access your personal data, rectify inaccurate data, delete your data (right to be forgotten), restrict processing, data portability, object to processing, withdraw consent at any time. To exercise these rights, contact privacy@scoutica.it or use the features available in your account settings.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.content: Your personal data is retained for the duration of your account. After account deletion, data is removed within 30 days, except for data required for legal or contractual obligations.

sharing.title: Data Sharing
sharing.content: Your data may be shared with: Stripe Inc. for payment processing, Resend for transactional emails, Cloudflare for content delivery. We do not sell your data to third parties.

security.title: Security
security.content: We adopt appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, including password encryption, HTTPS connections, and restricted data access.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: We use technical cookies necessary for site functionality (authentication session, language and theme preferences). We do not use profiling or third-party cookies for advertising purposes.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Welcome to Scoutica. By using our platform, you agree to the following terms and conditions.

service.title: The Service
service.content: Scoutica is an online platform connecting models with scouts, agencies, and brands for professional opportunities in the fashion industry.

eligibility.title: Eligibility Requirements
eligibility.content: To use Scoutica you must: be at least 18 years old, provide truthful and accurate information, not have been previously suspended from the platform.

accounts.title: Accounts and Profiles
accounts.content: You are responsible for the security of your account and the accuracy of the information provided. It is forbidden to create fake accounts, use photos of other people without consent, or provide false information.

conduct.title: Conduct
conduct.content: It is forbidden to: harass, intimidate or discriminate against other users, publish offensive or violent content, use the platform for illegal purposes, contact users outside the platform to circumvent the payment system.

ip.title: Intellectual Property
ip.content: You retain ownership of photos and content you upload to Scoutica. You grant Scoutica a non-exclusive license to display your content on the platform.

payments.title: Payments and Subscriptions
payments.content: Payments are processed via Stripe. Subscriptions renew automatically. You can cancel at any time; premium access remains active until the end of the paid period. Boosts are non-refundable.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.content: Scoutica is not responsible for: the accuracy of information provided by users, agreements made between users outside the platform, loss of data due to circumstances beyond our control.

termination.title: Suspension and Closure
termination.content: Scoutica may suspend or close your account if you violate these terms. You can delete your account at any time from settings.

changes.title: Changes to Terms
changes.content: We reserve the right to modify these terms. Significant changes will be communicated via email or in-platform notification.

law.title: Applicable Law
law.content: These terms are governed by Italian law. For any disputes, the Court of Milan has jurisdiction.

cookie.message: This site uses technical cookies necessary for the service to function.

deleteAccount.title: Delete Account
deleteAccount.warning: This action is irreversible. All your data, photos, messages, and applications will be permanently deleted.
